recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If Citation is restored to active core source in the future, preserve the FHIR-31864 outcome by using rankingOrder with the ranked contribution definition rather than reintroducing listOrder.
issue_request: FHIR-31864 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Citation change request raised against R4. It objected to Citation.citedArtifact.contributorship.entry.listOrder, and the final approved resolution was to rename that element to rankingOrder with a short description of ranked order of contribution and a definition describing numerical ranking of contributorship.
initial_application: Git commit 1a280a1986c08e286d074bbd498b2bd79c93ef8a, with message J# 31864, changed source/citation/structuredefinition-Citation.xml from listOrder to rankingOrder and added the approved definition. The R5 published Citation profile contains Citation.citedArtifact.contributorship.entry.rankingOrder with the same ranked contribution definition.
additional_context: Citation is not an active resource in the current core build: source/fhir.ini has no Citation entry in [resources], source/citation is absent, and current source searches find listOrder/rankingOrder only in checked-in historical release artifacts under tools/history. Later commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed Citation and other retired resources from core source. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion; a May 2021 CDS agenda only recorded an earlier proposed rejection before the later published Jira disposition.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build has no authoritative Citation source to edit, and the R5 publication surface already reflects the approved rename from listOrder to rankingOrder.
